text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While pondering training methods, I 
suddenly caught sight of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ――Phew! Sloped sprint done!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, my final stretch time is looking 
great! At this rate, we'll be totally 
unbeatable in the next mile race♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's doing training 
tailored for milers. Thinking I might 
glean some useful insight, I watch 
closely――

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right, next up is interval running! 
Let's see, distance and reps are――

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ten sets of half a mile makes 5 miles 
total! Time to build up some serious 
stamina~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One mile is 1600 meters, so... ten sets of 
800 meters, then? That's quite a unique 
way to count it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Alright, goooaaal!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Pacing was no problem...! Yep, I ran it 
all the way through!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Satisfaction level: a hundred miles~! Way 
to go, me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whew…… Guess it's about time to pack it up 
though. I've only got about 30 miles of 
energy left, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to become a true miler! I'm gonna 
train hard tomorrow too~!

text_block_list.text:
Yes! When it comes to love for the mile, I

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because being the strongest miler means 
being the strongest in the entire racing 
world!
choice_data_list:
That's some incredible confidence for the 
mile...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Mile races are truly 
incredible! You need faster legs than 
anyone else, but you also need enough 
stamina to sprint out the full mile!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~...! Truly the absolute strongest! 
Miles are the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So please watch me! I'll reach the 
pinnacle of the mile and prove it to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The strongest Umamusume is... Gran 
Alegria, and don't you forget it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, she who conquers the mile 
conquers the race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because being number one at the mile 
means... you can win any race out there!
choice_data_list:
...That feels like a bit of an 
exaggeration...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, I have faith! A true miler can handle 
a difference in distance just fine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A 0.75-mile sprint or a 1.25-mile 
middle-distance race! The strongest miler 
is totally invincible everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The potential of the mile spans infinite 
miles!
